people.name: Darius
people.line: Persian king who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple

people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

people.name: Shethar-bozenai
people.line: Persian official who questioned the Jews' temple rebuilding

people.name: Tattenai
people.line: Persian governor who questioned the Jews' authority to rebuild

translations.web: Then Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and their companions did accordingly with all diligence, because Darius the king had sent a decree.
translations.bsb: In response, Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates diligently carried out what King Darius had decreed.
translations.kjv: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
translations.asv: Then Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai, and their companions, because that Darius the king had sent, did accordingly with all diligence.
